description: Get a completed job's transcript. format=txt (default, human-readable) | srt (subtitles) | json-v2 (structured words, timings, speakers, translations, summary). Only works once the job status is "done". Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/transcript.

format.description: Output format. Default txt for readability; use json-v2 for structured results.

name: speechmatics_get_transcript
title: Get transcript
